snippet.title: The Shadowed Rune: Early Access trailer
snippet.description:
Enter The Shadowed Rune, a challenging family-friendly action roguelike where you can create millions of spell combinations using the power of runes. Explore a cursed tower filled with dangers, fight dark creatures, discover new areas, and unlock playable characters as you uncover the truth hidden behind the shadows.

🔥 In this new trailer you will see:
• Visual and lighting improvements
• The new playable character: Veld, the Arcane Hunter
• Enhanced animations and magic effects
• Updated environments and new enemies
• A first look at new systems and Early Access content
